description: This file contains utility functions for managing and validating sharded tensors in distributed training, including metadata building, validation, and recalculation of shard offsets and sizes.

classes.name: ShardedTensorMetadata
classes.description: Class representing metadata for a sharded tensor, including shard info and tensor properties.

classes.name: TensorProperties
classes.description: Class encapsulating tensor properties such as dtype, layout, requires_grad, and pin_memory.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Class representing a shard of a sharded tensor, including tensor data and metadata.

methods.name: _parse_and_validate_remote_device
methods.description: Parses and validates a remote device object, returning worker id and device.

methods.name: _validate_output_tensor_for_gather
methods.description: Validates the output tensor for a gather operation based on ranks and sizes.

methods.name: _flatten_tensor_size
methods.description: Validates and flattens a tensor size into a torch.Size object.

methods.name: _raise_if_mismatch
methods.description: Checks for mismatches in tensor properties across ranks or local shards.

methods.name: build_metadata_from_local_shards
methods.description: Builds local sharded tensor metadata from local shards and global size.

methods.name: build_global_metadata
methods.description: Aggregates local shard metadata from all ranks into global sharded tensor metadata.

methods.name: recalc_global_sharded_tensor_metadata
methods.description: Recalculates shard offsets and updates global size in sharded tensor metadata.
